run_render_pipeline: run the animated drawings render pipeline with a user-specified MVC configuration file path
start_render_with_config: start the render loop by loading an MVC config and creating the view, scene, and controller
create_view_scene_controller: create a view, scene, and controller from an MVC config and start the run loop
review_start_function: review the start function that orchestrates config loading, view creation, scene setup, and controller execution
refactor_render_entry: refactor the render entry point to support additional command-line arguments beyond the config file path
